text:
Maya: Heads-up — prepping Budget Radar for Starlight account for next week's review. Need token burn breakdown + onboarding gap analysis. Can we get a 30/60/90 usage slice and any heavy-embedding routes?
Liam: +1. Also want forecasted spend for next 90 days with current activation funnels. Any sudden spikes?
Arjun: I can pull the slices. Starting query now, will drop sample numbers.
Arjun: ```sql
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) as day, sum(tokens) as tokens, sum(embeddings) as embeds
FROM usage
WHERE account_id = 'starlight'
AND ts >= now() - interval '90 days'
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day;
```
FinanceOps: I'll run a burn forecast model after Arjun's numbers. Will include reserved capacity scenarios (dedicated vs hosted).
Maya: Good — also need onboarding status: how many active devs have completed the enablement guide vs still in sandbox. That feed will help recommend quota caps.
Eduardo: Onboarding pulse: 14 active devs, 6 completed guide, 2 flagged for account limits. Attaching short note: adjust alerts at 75% of free tier to avoid surprise.
Nina: I can do a 30-min enablement drop-in on Thurs 9am PT. @Maya @Eduardo confirm and I'll add calendar.
billing-bot: ALERT: Starlight exceeded daily embedding spend threshold yesterday. Link: https://redwood.internal/billing/alerts/AL-9987 :warning:
Liam: Ok — action items: Arjun to paste CSV with 30/60/90 breakouts by EOD, FinanceOps to publish forecast by tomorrow noon, Nina to run enablement on Thurs, Eduardo to propose alert thresholds and temporary quota. I'll draft slides for Budget Radar.
Maya: Thanks — owners noted. If anyone has customer feedback about model quality vs cost tradeoffs, drop into this thread. We'll incorporate into playbook. :thumbsup:
